name: abl-oeunit-test-explorer
description: Run and explore OpenEdge ABL unit tests using OEUnit

languageModelTools.name: oeunit_runTest
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run an OEUnit test file or single test method on an OpenEdge ABL project.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run an OEUnit test file (.cls) on the configured OpenEdge ABL project. Provide an absolute path to the .cls file. Optionally provide a testMethod name to run a single test method. Returns JSON with Status, Summary (Total/Failures/Errors/Skipped/DurationMs) and a TestCases array.

testFile.description: Absolute path to the .cls test file to run

testMethod.description: Name of a specific test method to run. Omit to run all test methods in the file.

languageModelTools.name: oeunit_runFolder
languageModelTools.userDescription: Discover and run all OEUnit test files inside a folder on an OpenEdge ABL project.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover and run all OEUnit test files (.cls files containing @Test methods) inside an absolute folder path. Returns aggregated results across all discovered test files with a per-file breakdown.

folder.description: Absolute path to the folder to search for test .cls files

languageModelTools.name: oeunit_getLastResults
languageModelTools.userDescription: Retrieve the cached results from the most recent OEUnit test run(s) without re-running tests.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns cached test results from the last OEUnit run(s). If 'file' is provided, returns results for that specific .cls file. Otherwise returns results for all recently run files. Results include Status, Summary and TestCases array identical to oeunit_runTest output. Useful for analysing or exporting results after running tests from the Test Explorer UI.

file.description: Absolute path to a specific .cls test file to retrieve cached results for. Omit to get results for all recently run files.

oeunit.testFilePattern.description: Glob pattern to find test files

oeunit.port.description: Starting port for OEUnit server(s). In a multi-project workspace each project is assigned port + index (0-based). A per-folder workspace setting overrides auto-assignment for that specific project.

oeunit.portEnd.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the auto-assigned OEUnit server port range. A warning is logged when no free port can be found within the range.

oeunit.timeout.description: Socket timeout in seconds for client connections and server reads (default: 60)

oeunit.loglevel.description: Log level for OEUnit server (info=all messages, warning=warning+error, error=error only)

oeunit.autostart.description: Automatically start the OEUnit server when the extension activates

oeunit.environmentVariables.description: Environment variables to set when starting the Progress executable. These can override DLC and PROPATH if needed.

oeunit.projectPaths.markdownDescription: Explicit list of project root folder paths. When non-empty, **overrides all automatic project discovery** — only these folders are used. Each entry must be the absolute path to a folder containing `openedge-project.json`. Use the **OEUnit: Add Project Folder…** command for a folder-picker dialog, or add/remove entries here directly.

oeunit.workspaceFolder.markdownDescription: **Deprecated** — no longer used. Project discovery now happens automatically from workspace folders. This setting is kept only to avoid an 'unknown configuration' warning for users who had it set previously.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
